name: What kind of termite damage is too extensive for AKN Design Group to address?

mainEntity.name: What kind of termite damage is too extensive for AKN Design Group to address?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in substantial residential renovations, including addressing structural issues that may arise from past termite damage, particularly within the context of a larger remodel or addition. While we excel at complex structural repairs and replacements integrated into a full renovation, projects solely focused on pest eradication or minor, isolated repairs without a broader remodel are outside our scope. Our expertise lies in transforming and enhancing functionality, beauty, and value, which includes ensuring the underlying structure is sound as part of a comprehensive design-build project. We always recommend contacting a specialized pest control service for active infestations prior to engaging us for remodel-related repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group handles structural termite damage repairs as part of substantial residential renovations, but we do not undertake isolated pest eradication or minor, standalone repairs.
